distanceStudy.title: What distance study means
paragraphs: This is not an on-demand or self-paced programme.
Study normally takes place during daytime working hours, and scheduled activities may occur approximately between 08:00 and 17:00.
Most lectures are delivered live, and recordings may be available only in limited cases.
distanceStudy.caveat: Arrangements can vary by course. Always verify current expectations through official LTU course information.

examinations.title: Examinations for distance students
paragraphs: Some examinations may be conducted online for admitted distance students.
The current course syllabus and examiner are authoritative.

thesisAtDistance.title: Thesis at a distance
paragraphs: Thesis work can often be performed partly or fully remotely.
Many thesis projects are completed with companies or organisations.
thesisAtDistance.caveat: This is general programme guidance, not a guarantee for every thesis project.

notes: Elective requirement is normally two 7.5 ECTS courses (15 ECTS total).
Optional Swedish course S0046P (3 ECTS) is outside the 120 ECTS degree.
This portfolio paraphrases official facts and is not an official LTU website.
